office_does: The treasurer collects property taxes and other county revenue, banks and invests the money of the county and its taxing districts, and manages county debt.
race_blurb: Appointed Treasurer Brittany Pearson, a Democrat with 25 years on the office's staff, faces Republican Randy Lewis, a retired actuary; the ballot fills the rest of this term and the next. Pearson led the primary 54% to 46%.

candidates.summary: Appointed Mason County Treasurer after 25 years in the Treasurer's Office, running on knowledge of the office 'from the ground up'.
highlights: 25 years in the Treasurer's Office: tax collection, county finance, banking, investments, management [S1]
Priorities: fiscal responsibility, accuracy, accessibility and customer service [S1]

experience.basis: 25-year career in the office she now leads by appointment; runs explicitly on experience and institutional knowledge.

candidates.summary: Mason County native and retired actuary, a member of the county Planning Advisory Commission, seeking his first elected office.
highlights: Retired actuary who chaired rate-setting and asset/liability committees for corporations [S1]
Would apply financial forecasting and risk management to county revenue and spending [S1]
Member of the Mason County Planning Advisory Commission [S1]

experience.basis: First-time candidate bringing private-sector actuarial experience to an office he has not worked in.
